safe_public_projection.label: Special Education / IEP
safe_public_projection.placeholder: My child's IEP meeting is next week. What changed from last year, and what should I ask?
starter_intents: What does the current plan give my child?
What changed since the last plan?
Is my child making progress on each goal?
What is missing or unclear in these documents?
What should I ask at the next meeting?

document_types.label: IEP Amendment
document_types.title_conflict: If the title zone says Individualized Education Program and does not say amendment, classify as iep.plan.

reading_notes.global: Extract every concept in the document type checklist, including repeats. One table row or one goal is one record. Quote the source text that holds the record. Every quoted field value must appear in that quote. Do not infer absent numbers, identities, relationships, or legal conclusions. A labelled empty field is field_present_but_empty. Distinguish observed, planned, and decided.

by_document_type.iep.plan: Session length is not duration. An explicit weekly total stays in frequency_text. Keep meeting date and IEP start date apart. Do not merge accuracy percent with words correct per minute. Split target value and accuracy criterion.
by_document_type.iep.amendment: Record the date of the IEP being amended. Extract only changed or added records, plus one amendment_change per affected section.
by_document_type.iep.progress: One progress_entry per goal per reporting period. Emit each reported score as a measurement with context progress_report.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.academic: One measurement per reported score, with instrument, task, score type, and administration date.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.psychoeducational: Composite and subtest scores are separate measurements.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.speech_language: One measurement per subtest or index.
by_document_type.iep.evaluation.independent: Do not judge agreement with district results.
by_document_type.iep.notice: One school_action per action. Keep proposes and refuses as the decision.
by_document_type.parent.correspondence: One parent_request per distinct request. Record a response only when it is in this document.
by_document_type.iep.service.implementation: These rows are observed delivery. They do not replace planned service rows.
by_document_type.iep.behavior.observation: Incidents are separate records. Do not merge them into a behavior plan.

plain_explainers.present_level: Where your child is now, in words and numbers, and how it affects learning in the regular classroom.
plain_explainers.goal: What the plan says your child will learn, how it will be measured, and the starting point.
plain_explainers.short_term_objective: A smaller step toward an annual goal.
plain_explainers.service: The help the plan describes: what it is, how often, for how long, where, and from when to when.
plain_explainers.accommodation: A change to how your child learns or is tested. A modification changes what is expected. The document's own label decides which.
plain_explainers.placement: How much of the day the plan says your child spends with students who do not have disabilities.
plain_explainers.assessment_participation: How the plan says your child takes state and district tests.
plain_explainers.transition: What the plan says about life after high school.
plain_explainers.progress_entry: The school's report on a goal for a period. Not a grade.
plain_explainers.amendment_change: A change to named parts of an existing plan. The rest stays in effect.
plain_explainers.school_action: The school's written notice of something it proposes or refuses, and the reasons it wrote down.
plain_explainers.eligibility: The decision the team wrote about whether the child qualifies, and under which category.
plain_explainers.service_delivery_observation: Time or sessions a log says were provided. A missing log does not show that help was withheld.

professional_questions: Which plan sections are present, blank, or not found in the upload?
What changed across plan versions and amendments, and what was the scope?
Where do evaluators or documents disagree?
What does each measure series show over time?

outcomes.label: Understand how well the plan addresses documented needs
See progress and changes over time
Prepare questions for the next IEP meeting
Review discrepancies, delivery questions, and evidence gaps

canonical_questions.canonical_question: How well does the IEP address the child's documented educational needs?
canonical_questions.trigger_notes: Include when the pinned IEP pack applies and at least one in-scope IEP document is present. Do not require persona selection.

source_basis.purpose: Explain why plan completeness and alignment matter for parents and advocates.

coverage_requirements.minimum: At least one verified document classified as an IEP-domain type in the Hive upload.
coverage_requirements.operative_plan_preferred: Verified records from document type iep.plan, or a later plan version linked by succeeds_plan, for full dimension coverage.

canonical_questions.unresolved_behavior: Report each dimension as SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, UNRESOLVED, or NOT_FOUND_IN_REVIEWED_SCOPE with explicit scope (supplied documents only). Missing upload content is not proof an item does not exist outside the upload.
suggested_follow_ups: Which additional plan or evaluation documents would make this review more complete?
Was a goal area discussed in an evaluation but not reflected on the current plan?

customer.structure: Plain-language summary by dimension: what the documents show, what is unclear, and neutral questions to ask.

professional.structure: Dimension table with assertion ids, source document, page, relationship state, and investigation disposition.

canonical_questions.canonical_question: How is the child progressing, and what has changed over time?
canonical_questions.trigger_notes: Include for customer view when at least two time-ordered documents exist, or when both a plan (iep.plan) and a progress report (iep.progress) are in scope.

source_basis.purpose: Parents need a chronological story of progress and plan changes, not a grade.

coverage_requirements.minimum: At least one verified goal or progress_entry, or verified measurement linked to a goal.
coverage_requirements.preferred: Operative plan plus at least one progress_entry or compatible measurement after the plan effective date.
coverage_requirements.temporal_axis: document ordering dates and measurement.observed_on / progress_entry.reporting_period

canonical_questions.unresolved_behavior: Describe verified baseline and any verified progress numbers separately. State when progress reports or later measurements are absent from the upload. Do not infer lack of progress.
suggested_follow_ups: Are progress reports available for periods named in the plan?
Has the plan been amended or replaced since the last report you uploaded?

customer.structure: Timeline: where things started (baseline), what the school reported since, what changed on the plan, and what remains unknown.

canonical_questions.canonical_question: What should I discuss at the next IEP meeting?
canonical_questions.trigger_notes: Also suggested (not forced) as baseline when iep.plan is present even without the word meeting.

source_basis.purpose: Meeting preparation from supplied records only.

coverage_requirements.minimum: Verified current plan goals or services from iep.plan, or the latest operative plan version in the upload.
coverage_requirements.meeting_context_optional: iep.meeting.notice or iep.meeting.notes when present; never assumed.

canonical_questions.unresolved_behavior: List what the upload establishes and prioritize unresolved investigations as neutral discussion topics. Missing progress reports yield questions about reporting, not claims that progress did not occur.
suggested_follow_ups: Can we review progress data for each goal since the last meeting?
Were any evaluation findings not reflected in current goals or services?

customer.structure: Bulleted discussion topics grouped by goals, services, accommodations, and open questions. Each topic ties to a verified quote or an explicit UNRESOLVED gap.

canonical_questions.canonical_question: What discrepancies, service-delivery questions, and evidence gaps require further review?
canonical_questions.trigger_notes: Include for professional view when the IEP pack applies. Does not expand who may access the Hive.

source_basis.purpose: Advocate-oriented review tasks grounded in verified assertions.
source_basis.note: Professional review standards are outside this pack; citations in regulatory_overlay remain question-only.

coverage_requirements.minimum: At least one verified IEP-domain document.
coverage_requirements.discrepancy_definition: Supported find_disagreement or conflicting_evaluations disposition, or side-by-side assertions with different parties and same area.
coverage_requirements.delivery_definition: service_commitment_versus_delivery only when service_delivery_observation exists; otherwise list as evidence_gap.
coverage_requirements.evidence_gap_definition: identify_gap investigations with NOT_FOUND_IN_REVIEWED_SCOPE or UNRESOLVED, never as proof of non-performance.

canonical_questions.unresolved_behavior: Separate discrepancies (supported conflicting assertions), delivery comparisons (supported or UNRESOLVED), and gaps (missing documents or unlinked records). Never upgrade gaps to violations.
suggested_follow_ups: Request service implementation logs for the periods compared.
Obtain independent evaluation or prior plan versions if identity links are unresolved.

professional.structure: Sections: discrepancies, delivery comparisons, evidence gaps, chronology notes, unresolved identity. Each line cites assertion ids and investigation id.

measure.description: One construct across present levels, evaluations, goals, and progress so a series does not mix measures.

vocabulary.note: Starter set copied from V2 v0.3. Definitions are reading aids, not facts about a child.

abbreviations.PLAAFP: present levels of academic achievement and functional performance

definitions.definition: How long a service runs, from its start date to its end date. Not the length of one session.
Where a service is delivered. Different from placement.
How much of the day a child spends with peers who do not have disabilities, and the setting overall.
The starting measurement stated in a goal. Not automatically the most recent score.
A change to named parts of an existing IEP. A new IEP is a later plan, not an amendment.
Movement toward an annual goal as reported. Not a grade.
A change in how a child learns or is tested, not in what is expected.
A change in what a child is expected to learn or demonstrate.
Glossary expansion only. Not a finding about a particular child.

regulatory_overlay.source_policy: Citations are references. They are not evidence that an event occurred.

rules.description: Present levels, including how the disability affects involvement and progress in the general curriculum.
Measurable annual goals, academic and functional.
Benchmarks or short-term objectives when an alternate assessment is stated.
How progress toward each goal is measured and when reports are provided.
Services with projected start, frequency, location, and duration.
Explanation of the extent the child will not participate with nondisabled children.
Assessment participation, accommodations, or why an alternate is used.
Why the child cannot participate in the regular assessment and why the alternate is appropriate.
Transition content from the IEP in effect when the child turns 16, as cited. Not a finding.
Rights-transfer statement. Blocked until a reviewed age-of-majority table exists.
Notice describes the action, why, the evaluation basis, options considered, and other factors.
